title: AiBatchCreateRequest
description: ai.batch-create-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/batches on OpenVibe.AI (capability ai.batches.create). One batch of many prompts: the answers come later, and the batch is billed at half the retail price. Errors are problem+json: 422 input.invalid (no items, an empty prompt, a prompt over 20000 characters, a deadline outside 1 to 72 hours), 422 batch.too_large (more prompts than the service's cap), 403 batch.no_payer (the token names no account to pay), 403 batch.no_grant (a service without the ai.batches.create grant).

items.description: The prompts of the batch, in order. Each item is a prompt, or an object with a prompt and the model it wants.

model.description: The model this item wants (a model key, or provider/model).
The model the whole batch asks for, when no item names one.

deadline_hours.description: How long the batch may take, in hours (1 to 72). Omitted: the service's own default (24 hours). A prompt that reaches the deadline without cheap capacity expires and is never charged.
